create.required: Campbooks needs one workspace to hold your mail, people and documents. Everything else can wait.

name.title: What should we call your workspace?
name.titleAnother: What should we call the new workspace?
name.lead: Your company’s name works well, or something like “Household” for personal things.
name.label: Workspace name
name.tooLong: Keep it to 100 characters or fewer.

kind.title: What is it for?
kind.lead: This picks its colour, so you can tell your workspaces apart at a glance. If you skip, it’s a business workspace.
kind.label: What the workspace is for
kind.business: Clients, suppliers, invoices and a team.

done.title: {{name}} is ready
done.lead: Nothing needs you yet. Invite the people you work with, or have a look around.

code.title: Do you have a signup code?
code.lead: This Campbooks asks for a code before someone creates their first workspace. Whoever runs it can give you one.
code.label: Signup code
code.invalid: That code didn’t work. Check it and try again.

inviteOnly.title: You need an invitation
inviteOnly.lead: This Campbooks only lets people in by invitation. Ask someone who uses it to invite you, then open the link they give you.

approval.title: Your request is waiting
approval.lead: Someone who runs this Campbooks approves new accounts. Your request is with them; check again later.

failed.title: Couldn’t create the workspace
failed.lead: Campbooks didn’t answer. Nothing was created.

members.title: Members
members.lead: Everyone in {{workspace}} and what they can do.
members.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}} from {{workspace}}? They lose access right away. To bring them back, invite them again.
members.readOnly: Only owners and admins can invite people or change roles.

errors.lastOwner: A workspace needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.forbidden: Only owners can change or remove an owner.
errors.generic: That didn’t work, and nothing changed. Try again.

loadError.title: Couldn’t load the members
loadError.lead: Campbooks didn’t answer. Nothing was lost.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.lead: An invitation lasts 7 days. Campbooks doesn’t email invitations yet, so whoever runs this Campbooks needs to pass the link on.

errors.email: Enter a full email address, like name@example.com.
errors.generic: The invitation wasn’t created. Try again.

used.title: This invitation was already used
used.lead: If you accepted it, the workspace is already in your list.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.lead: Ask whoever invited you to invite you again.

alreadyMember.title: You’re already a member
alreadyMember.lead: This workspace is already in your list.

mismatch.title: This invitation is for another email address
mismatch.lead: You’re signed in as {{email}}. Sign out, then sign in with the address the invitation was sent to.

notFound.title: This invitation link doesn’t work
notFound.lead: Check that you copied the whole link, or ask for a new invitation.
